svg.title: Mell roadmap
svg.desc: Nine phases. Phases 0 to 2 form v0.1: foundation, core chat, memory and first tools, followed by a quality gate. Then the desktop shell with apps and system controls on the Linux host, capabilities such as media and web plus assisted memory, voice, agents and automation, import, hardening.
svg.text: EACH PHASE ENDS WITH A WORKING SYSTEM
Nothing after Phase 2 starts before the gate passes.
